description: This file defines the AdhocMetric class and related functions for handling ad-hoc metrics in a data visualization context, including parsing, comparison, and SQL translation.

classes.name: AdhocMetric
classes.description: Class representing an ad-hoc metric with methods for SQL translation, comparison, duplication, and validation.

methods.name: inferSqlExpressionColumn
methods.description: Infers the column name from a SQL expression if it matches auto-generated pattern.

methods.name: inferSqlExpressionAggregate
methods.description: Infers the aggregate function from a SQL expression if it matches auto-generated pattern.

methods.name: getDefaultLabel
methods.description: Returns the default label for the metric, translating to SQL.

methods.name: translateToSql
methods.description: Converts the metric to its SQL string representation, with options for verbose names and count-distinct transformation.

methods.name: duplicateWith
methods.description: Creates a new AdhocMetric instance with overridden fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another AdhocMetric instance.

methods.name: inferSqlExpressionAggregate
methods.description: Public method to infer SQL aggregate from the metric.

methods.name: inferSqlExpressionColumn
methods.description: Public method to infer SQL column from the metric.
